item.title: Rockstar posts a new launch gallery of GTA 6 screenshots
item.guid: 2026-11-05-Rockstar posts a new launch gallery of GTA 6 screenshots
item.description: Two weeks out, Rockstar added a fresh batch of official screenshots to the GTA 6 site, showing Vice City nightlife, wildlife, chases and diving around Leonida. No story details, just a last look before November 19. (Reported by PC Gamer)

item.title: Data firm estimates GTA 6 pre-orders near 7.7 million
item.guid: 2026-11-04-Data firm estimates GTA 6 pre-orders near 7.7 million
item.description: Sensor Tower estimates about 7.71 million console pre-orders worth roughly $751 million, around three quarters on PS5. This is a third-party estimate; Rockstar and Take-Two have not shared sales figures. (Reported by Kotaku)

item.title: Pre-load moves up to November 10 and needs up to 212GB
item.guid: 2026-11-03-Pre-load moves up to November 10 and needs up to 212GB
item.description: Rockstar set digital pre-load for November 10: midnight local time on PS5, midnight GMT on Xbox. Boxed copies hold a code that arrives November 12. Clear up to 212GB. We had listed November 12 for everyone; the facts table is now corrected. (Reported by Rockstar Newswire)

item.title: Rockstar releases the GTA 6 launch trailer
item.description: A 90-second trailer captured on PS5 opens on Jason's exit from the army and Lucia calling him from prison, then runs through heists and chases ahead of the November 19 launch. (Reported by GameBrief)

item.title: Rockstar publishes formal mod rules that will cover GTA 6
item.guid: 2026-09-10-Rockstar publishes formal mod rules that will cover GTA 6
item.description: Story expansions and cross-game mashups are banned, and mods can only be sold through storefronts Rockstar approves. No crypto, gambling or selling in-game cash. (Reported by Game Developer)

item.title: NoPixel V opens a closed beta on the Rockstar Games Launcher
item.guid: 2026-09-08-NoPixel V opens a closed beta on the Rockstar Games Launcher
item.description: The best-known GTA V roleplay server now launches from Rockstar's own client for about 450 invited players, the clearest sign yet that Rockstar backs roleplay. (Reported by Runtime Wire)

item.title: Early preview adds detail on cars, pawn shops and an in-game social feed
item.guid: 2026-08-31-Early preview adds detail on cars, pawn shops and an in-game social feed
item.description: A streamer Rockstar invited to a hands-off preview described GPS trackers on high-end cars that a mechanic must remove, pawn shops that buy stolen goods, and a short-video social network inside the game. (Reported by GamingBible)
